profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc is a public company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, and trades under the ticker CLS. On its own website, the company describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. It says it engineers, designs and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud and hybrid cloud while advancing technologies in what it calls high-growth markets. The company also points to a global network and a team it credits with helping customers achieve a competitive advantage.

The record held on the company lists no products and no lawsuits, and no MCP servers are associated with it. Its filings identify it with the CIK number 0001030894.
